lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……去他妈的。

lines.en: I sigh to myself as I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone- knowing that, unless sudden tragedy has struck (Which wouldn’t be {i}too{/i} uncommon around here) that she’s a package deal now.
lines.zh: 我一边点下手机里 Kaori 的名字，一边暗自叹气——我知道，除非突然降临了什么悲剧（在这儿这种事可不算{i}少见{/i}），她现在已经是「买一送一」了。

lines.en: That’s right, imaginary audience that I talk to all the time for reasons both you and I don’t understand — {i}somehow{/i} Kaori managed to track down the only other person in Kumon-mi with heterochromia.
lines.zh: 没错，我一直对着说话的假想观众——至于为什么，你我都搞不懂——{i}不知怎么地{/i}，Kaori 居然找到了 Kumon-mi 里唯一另一个有虹膜异色症的人。

lines.en: Or, as she refers to it, {i}special{/i} eyes.
lines.zh: 或者，按她的说法，{i}特别{/i}的眼睛。

lines.en: For Kaori, I’m not sure if I’d go that far as, unless I’m misremembering what little of her backstory I’ve been able to discern, she’s {i}always{/i} looked like that.
lines.zh: 至于 Kaori，我倒不确定能不能算进去——除非我记错了她身上那点我能看出来的过往，她{i}一直{/i}都是那个样子。
Nao 是……

lines.en: Well, let’s just say I’m still having a hard time accepting that we just randomly discovered a little girl with eyes matching Ami and Maya for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: 这么说吧，我到现在还是很难接受，我们就这么毫无理由地偶然发现了一个眼睛和 Ami、Maya 一样的小女孩。

lines.en: There’s something more to this, just...
lines.zh: 这里面还有别的东西，只是……

lines.en: The chances of me ever figuring that out while Nao can’t talk and Kaori can’t talk {i}well{/i} are very slim.
lines.zh: 在 Nao 不会说话、Kaori 又说不{i}好{/i}的情况下，我能弄明白的几率非常渺茫。

lines.en: But hey, maybe Kaori’s been doing an exemplary job as a “mothermom” in my absence and Nao has suddenly evolved or something.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也许我不在的时候，Kaori 这个「妈妈妈」当得堪称模范，Nao 已经突然进化了什么的。

lines.en: Like always, there’s only one way to find out.
lines.zh: 和往常一样，只有一种办法能知道答案。
: ……为什么？

lines.en: : Your talk-voice must not be big when there are word-drenched paper blocks present!
lines.zh: : 有浸满字的纸块在场的时候，你说话的声音不可以很大！
: 你……在图书馆？

lines.en: : Incorrect! I collected my own knowledge blocks and am helping Nao-chan memorize the best words! Like “greyscale” or “muskrat!” And having a big voice will make the words dissolve!
lines.zh: : 不对！我自己收集了知识块，正在帮 Nao-chan 记住最好的词！比如「灰阶」或者「麝鼠」！而且声音太大的话，那些词会化掉的！

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. I forgot that’s why silence is heavily enforced in libraries. It has nothing to with disturbing anyone.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。我忘了图书馆之所以严格要求安静，就是这个原因。和打扰别人一点关系都没有。
: 你被忘怀了。
: 你要说的是「被原谅」。
: 你是谁？
: 也许你也不知道。
: 你好！

lines.en: : Kaori, I’m not waiting for you to invite me any longer. I’m coming over.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我不等你邀请了。我现在就过去。

lines.en: : But I am being you — a human teacher for small girl who needs my help!
lines.zh: : 可我正在当「你」——当一个需要我帮助的小女孩的人类老师！

lines.en: : Then you won’t mind if I come check your progress. No one is a better authority on me than myself. Or maybe Ami. Or Maya. Or Niki.
lines.zh: : 那我过来检查你的进度，你也不会介意了。在「我」这件事上，没有谁比我更有权威。也许 Ami 有。或者 Maya。或者 Niki。

lines.en: : Cotton candy girl! Are her legs still where they’re meant to be?
lines.zh: : 棉花糖女孩！她的腿还在该在的地方吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, she’s doing fine. But we can talk more about her when I get to your place.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她挺好的。不过等我到了你家，我们再多聊聊她。
: 可是 Nao-chan——

lines.en: I hang up the phone and begin to make my way over to Kaori’s apartment in a much better mood than I’ve been the last several times I’ve gone there.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，动身往 Kaori 的公寓去，心情比我之前几次去那儿时要好得多。

lines.en: And no, it has nothing to do with the fact that I’m getting two potential aliens for the price of one.
lines.zh: 不，这和我花一份价钱得到两个潜在外星人这件事一点关系都没有。

lines.en: But it has {i}everything{/i} to do with how things have been looking up lately.
lines.zh: 而是和最近一切都在好转这件事{i}完全{/i}有关。

lines.en: I love my niece and all of the things she does.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女，也爱她做的所有事。

lines.en: I love my childhood friend slash ex-girlfriend slash idol and how she’s helping me learn to walk again.
lines.zh: 我爱我的青梅竹马／前女友／偶像，也爱她正在帮我重新学会走路。

lines.en: And I’m closer to Maya than ever before.
lines.zh: 我和 Maya 比以往任何时候都亲近。

lines.en: Well, in this life at least. From what I understand, I’ve been {i}very{/i} close to her in the past.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少这一世是这样。据我所知，我从前和她{i}非常{/i}亲近。

lines.en: It’s all smiles and sunshine for me.
lines.zh: 对我来说，一切都充满了笑容和阳光。
不可能出什么差错。
不可能出什么差错。
不可能出什么差错。

lines.en: Tonight is going to be a good night.
lines.zh: 今晚会是美好的一晚。

lines.en: This is a feeling I have which means that it must be true because it is a feeling I have it is a feeling I have it is a feeling I have and I have this feeling that I have and it’s going to be good.
lines.zh: 这是我有一种感觉，所以它就一定是真的，因为这是我有一种感觉，我有一种感觉，我有一种感觉，我有着这个我拥有的感觉，而它会是美好的。

lines.en: There are nineteen different ways to brew coffee (That I am aware of).
lines.zh: 冲咖啡有十九种不同的方法（就我所知）。

lines.en: I will now tell you about them.
lines.zh: 现在我来讲给你们听。
开玩笑的啦 lol。

lines.en: : And that combination of letters means “dodgeball!” It is a game where you dodge a ball! Do you understand, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 那串字母的意思是「躲避球」！就是躲开一个球的游戏！你明白吗，Nao-chan？

lines.en: : Hi Kaori. I promise that nothing followed me on the way here.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Kaori。我保证，来的路上什么东西都没跟着我。

lines.en: : Friendtruder! You entered the housing-cube so very quietly! I am impressed by your ability to remain undetected! Are you the ninja?
lines.zh: : 朋友入侵者！你进这个居住立方体的时候太安静了！你这种不被察觉的能力让我佩服！你是忍者吗？

lines.en: : Yes, that is me. How go Nao’s apparent lessons? Is she able to read yet?
lines.zh: : 对，就是我。Nao 那些所谓的课程进展如何？她能读了吗？

lines.en: : No! But it is the thinking that counts and if you think hard enough you can count every number there is!
lines.zh: : 没有！不过重要的是在思考，而且只要你够用力地想，就能把所有的数字都数一遍！

lines.en: : I only wish there were better fruits to teach her with as this mango is both not edible and has too many pictures of females in tiny skirts.
lines.zh: : 我只希望有更好的水果来教她，因为这个芒果既不能吃，上面还有太多穿小裙子的女性图片。

lines.en: : Manga. Not a fruit. And it would probably be best to teach her with actual books rather than comics.
lines.zh: : 那是漫画，不是水果。而且教她用真正的书，大概比用漫画好。

lines.en: : Oh, great. You’ve already got her hooked on them, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。你已经让她上瘾了，对吧？

lines.en: : Nao-chan loves the picture mango. It is her favorite fruit that isn’t a fruit but is still a fruit because the mango is a fruit.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 最爱图画芒果。那是她最喜欢的水果，虽然它不是水果却依然是水果，因为芒果是一种水果。

lines.en: : As long as she doesn’t turn into another Molly, I’m sure it will be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要她别变成另一个 Molly，我相信就没问题。

lines.en: : Would you like to assist me in the reformatting of the Nao-chan brain, Friendtruder? You have more experience with this than I do and understand so many more words.
lines.zh: : 你愿意帮我重新格式化 Nao-chan 的大脑吗，朋友入侵者？你在这件事上比我更有经验，也懂多得多的词。

lines.en: : Maybe another time. I feel suddenly compelled to go outside with you while leaving Nao inside to read on her own.
lines.zh: : 改天吧。我突然很想和你一起出去，把 Nao 留在里面自己看。

lines.en: : That does not sound like an effective means of instruction.
lines.zh: : 这听起来不像是一种有效的教学方式。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll be fine. I just really think we should go outside.
lines.zh: : 我相信她不会有事的。我只是真的觉得我们应该出去。
: 没有东西跟着我到这儿来。

lines.en: : This is the one-plus-oneth time you have mentioned being followed. If there is a wild human animal outside, all you need to do is make yourself look large and it will likely run away.
lines.zh: : 这已经是你第「一加一」次提起被人跟着了。如果外面有野生的动物，你只要把自己弄得很高大，它很可能就会跑掉。

lines.en: : It is human nature to run away from things that are much bigger than you. That is why I avoid the long-necked wrong-horse.
lines.zh: : 人类天生就会躲开比自己大得多的东西。所以我才会躲着那种长脖子的错误马。

lines.en: : There’s nothing here. Nothing followed me.
lines.zh: : 这儿什么都没有。没有东西跟着我。

lines.en: : Why are you suddenly the strange one? That is my occupation.
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然变成奇怪的那个了？那是我的专职。
: 我们出去吧。

lines.en: : Nao-chan, be the good girl and eat your mango while I talk to Friend. But eat with knowledge and not your mouth bones. This is not that kind of mango.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan，做个好女孩，我朋友说话的时候，你乖乖吃你的芒果。不过要用知识去吃，不是用你嘴里的骨头。这不是那种芒果。

lines.en: : Come, Friend! But have the quickness! Show me what did not or did follow you!
lines.zh: : 来吧，朋友！但要快一点！让我看看有什么跟着你了、或者没跟着你！

lines.en: : Nothing followed me. I already told you that. Stop being so weird.
lines.zh: : 没有东西跟着我。我说过了。别这么奇怪了。

lines.en: : It appears that you did not fill your pockets with deceit before arriving here.
lines.zh: : 看来你来这儿之前，并没有在口袋里塞满谎言。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’d lie to you? What would I have to gain from that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会骗你？我骗你能得到什么？

lines.en: : My collection of circular earth-bits so you can defend yourself from whatever furry non-friend follows you next. Is that your main fear, friend? Because mine is the color green.
lines.zh: : 我收藏的那些圆形土块，这样下次再有什么毛茸茸的非朋友跟着你，你就能自卫了。那是你最大的恐惧吗，朋友？因为我最怕的是绿色。

lines.en: : I’m not after your rock collection. I just wanted to spend some time with you away from Nao.
lines.zh: : 我不是来图你的石头收藏的。我只是想和你单独待一会儿，不带 Nao。

lines.en: : Do you not like Nao-chan? Because Nao-chan is the good girl. She does the good things and will one day become the good woman.
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢 Nao-chan 吗？Nao-chan 可是个好女孩。她做的好事，将来会让她变成一个好女人。

lines.en: : I don’t have a {i}problem{/i} with her. It took me a little to warm up to you as well. But tonight, I just felt like I should be with you. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我对她没{i}意见{/i}。我对不也是花了点时间才熟络起来的。不过今晚，我就是觉得应该和你待在一起。就这样。

lines.en: : You felt...like you should be with me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得……应该和我在一起？
: 为什么？

lines.en: : It’s just a feeling. I don’t really know how to describe it.
lines.zh: : 只是一种感觉。我真不知道该怎么形容。
: 脸好烫！

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re blushing pretty intensely all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你突然脸红得挺厉害。

lines.en: : I apologize for changing colors. I understand humans should not do that and you are probably scared. But I will not hurt you the way you are afraid wild animals will.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我变了颜色。我明白人类不该这样，你大概也吓到了。不过我不会像你害怕野生动物那样去伤害你。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of wild animals. In fact, I’m not really afraid of anything. I just wanted you to know that I am here alone and that I want to be with you while you are also alone.
lines.zh: : 我不怕野生动物。事实上，我根本没什么好怕的。我只是想让你知道，我是独自一人来的，而我想和你待在一起，在你也是独自一人的时候。

lines.en: : But if you are the alone and I am also the alone does that not mean we are together? Or is that another kind of alone? Like mango and mango.
lines.zh: : 可如果我是独自一人，你也是独自一人，这不就代表我们在一起了吗？还是说那是另一种独自？就像芒果和芒果。

lines.en: : Please just talk to me. About anything. I don’t want to be home right now. It’s not safe.
lines.zh: : 求你跟我说说话吧。说什么都行。我现在不想待在家里。那里不安全。
: 不安全？……

lines.en: : It isn’t safe anywhere. Everywhere I go I see her and I don’t want to see her and I don’t want to remember and I know I have to but I can’t and I don’t want to and you don’t understand any of that-
lines.zh: : 哪里都不安全。不管我走到哪儿都能看见她，我不想看见她，也不想记起来，我知道我必须记起来可我做不到，我也不想，而你完全不明白这些——

lines.en: : Which is why I’m here. Please keep me company. I’m not afraid of anything, I swear.
lines.zh: : 所以我才来这儿。求你陪陪我。我什么都不怕，我发誓。
: 我明白了。

lines.en: : The Queen of Spiders will let you rest in her web — but only under one condition.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛女王会让你在她的网里歇息——不过只有一个条件。
: 什么条件？

lines.en: : That you tell me who you’re running from.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我，你在躲着谁。
: 什么？不。什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Friend? What seems to be the problemo? That is the Spain word for “problem.” You’ll never guess where they say that.
lines.zh: : 朋友？出了什么 problemo？那是西班牙话里的「问题」。你绝对猜不到他们在哪儿这么说。
: 你的眼睛……它们……

lines.en: : They are special and made of a clear, jelly-like collagen.
lines.zh: : 它们很特别，是由一种清澈的、果冻状的胶原蛋白构成的。

lines.en: : They help me see things and sometimes they get all ahhhhhh when I am awake for longer than I should be.
lines.zh: : 它们帮我看东西，有时候我醒着的时间超过该醒的时长，它们就会变得 ahhhhhh 的。

lines.en: : What more would you like to know about them?
lines.zh: : 你还想知道关于它们的什么？
: 你不是……
: 是谁……

lines.en: : I am Kaori! The Queen of Spiders! The Mistress of the Dark! The greatest waitress in all of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 我是 Kaori！蜘蛛女王！黑暗女王！全 Kumon-mi 最伟大的服务员！

lines.en: : But most importantly, I am your-
lines.zh: : 不过最重要的是，我是你的——

lines.en: : My fleshy exterior feels very tingly all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我那肉质的外表突然觉得很麻。
准备好了吗？！
很好！！！

lines.en: THEN COUNT IT DOWN WITH ME!
lines.zh: 那就跟我一起倒数！
M！
鹦鹉！
什么都没有！
圆圈！
而最重要的是……
T！
{i}Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!{/i}
: 嗯！嗯唔！嗯！
{i}又提升了！{/i}
: 嗯！嗯唔！嗯唔！！
{i}又提升了！{/i}
: 嗯！嗯唔！嗯唔！嗯——！
{i}哇哦！{/i}

lines.en: : Mm! Mmmm! Mm! Chm! Chmp! Mnch! Mm!
lines.zh: : 嗯！嗯——！嗯！啾！啾唔！嗯唔！嗯！
{i}她一定非常喜欢亲吻！{/i}
: 还要……
: 这他妈是——
: 朋……朋友！
: 我……停不……下来！
: Kaori——

lines.en: : {b}月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月月!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!{/b}

lines.en: I’m not sure how long this goes on for.
lines.zh: 我不确定这样持续了多久。

lines.en: And, to be even more honest, I’m not even sure if it’s really happening right now or not.
lines.zh: 再说得诚实点，我甚至不确定此刻是不是真的在发生。

lines.en: I’m obviously no stranger to nonsensical scenarios, but this is really just way too much.
lines.zh: 我显然对荒诞的场景并不陌生，可这实在太过了。
它来得毫无预兆。
气氛全都不对。
可即便如此……

lines.en: And yet her tongue is like novocaine.
lines.zh: 可她的舌头就像奴佛卡因。

lines.en: It kills off all the pain and makes me numb.
lines.zh: 它杀死了所有的痛，让我麻木。
今晚我需要这个。

lines.en: It came in a different way than I expected it to, and who knows if it will ever come again...
lines.zh: 它来得和我预想的方式不同，而且谁知道它还会不会再来……
不过现在——

lines.en: I close my eyes and kiss her back.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，回吻她。

lines.en: Because I’m not just content with feeling numb-
lines.zh: 因为我并不只是满足于感到麻木——
我更喜欢麻木。
{i}这{/i}对我来说是正常的。

lines.en: {i}This{/i} is what I’m meant to be.
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}就是我该成为的样子。
困惑。
害怕。

lines.en: And with my tongue in a pretty girl’s mouth.
lines.zh: 还有，把舌头伸进一个漂亮女孩的嘴里。
什么也不说，什么也感觉不到。
我永远只会是这样。
我永远只会想要这样。
: 嗯！嗯唔！嗯……
: 嗯！哼！嗯唔！啾唔！啾——！

lines.en: I wonder if I should stop her.
lines.zh: 我在想，是不是该让她停下来。

lines.en: The moments leading up to this are expectedly blurry but, I can’t imagine any world in which Kaori would willingly throw herself at me like this out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 在此之前的那几个瞬间，果然是模糊的，可我无法想象在任何一个世界里，Kaori 会这样毫无预兆地主动扑上来。

lines.en: And that means a lot since I have seen several worlds at this point and am becoming a bit of an expert when it comes to them.
lines.zh: 这话很有分量，毕竟到这一步我已经见过好几个世界，在这方面也算有点专家的样子了。
嗯……我大概该停下来了。

lines.en: Especially now that we have a spectator.
lines.zh: 尤其是现在我们有观众了。
: Kaori。
: 啊？什么？啊？

lines.en: : Why the closeness?! And the hot face again?! And why does my mouth muscle have more wetness than the normal amount of wetness it normally has?!
lines.zh: : 为什么这么近？！还有脸又烫了？！还有为什么我的嘴部肌肉比它平时正常的湿润度还要湿？！

lines.en: : I imagine it's because you just forced yourself on me.
lines.zh: : 我想，是因为你刚才对我强行非礼了。

lines.en: : What...did I do? What does “force yourself” mean?
lines.zh: : 我……做了什么？「强行非礼」是什么意思？

lines.en: : It can mean a number of things. But in this case, you pushed me up against the wall and starting making out with me.
lines.zh: : 它可以有很多意思。不过在这里，就是你把我按在墙上，然后开始和我热吻。

lines.en: : You can not make “out,” Friend. Out is a direction. Please explain the situation with different words because one second things were normal things but the next they were red and bubbly things!
lines.zh: : 你不能「make out」，朋友。out 是个方向。请换些词来解释这个情况，因为前一秒一切还是正常的东西，下一秒就变成了红色冒泡的东西！

lines.en: : You kissed me. And quite aggressively at that.
lines.zh: : 你亲了我。而且还相当凶猛。

lines.en: : You do know what a kiss is, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么是亲吻吧？

lines.en: : Yes. But we are friends. We can not do the kiss. That would make us special friends and I do not want to make a new human yet.
lines.zh: : 知道。可我们是朋友。我们不能亲。那样会让我们变成特殊的朋友，而我还不想制造一个人类。

lines.en: : It takes a little more than kissing to do that, just FYI.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，要造人可不只是亲吻就够的。

lines.en: : I understand human mating rituals. What I do not understand is why there would be a kiss. This is not a thing I would do. I don’t want a special friend.
lines.zh: : 我懂人类的交配仪式。我不懂的是为什么会有亲吻。这不是我会做的事。我不想要特殊的朋友。

lines.en: : First off, harsh. Second, I’m not going to hold it against you. I’ve been in a...similar situation once before.
lines.zh: : 首先，这话真伤人。其次，我不会怪你。我以前也遇到过……类似的情况。
: 那个「情况」最后怎么样了？

lines.en: : The girl it happened {i}with{/i} wound up rightfully despising me for the rest of...forever. She hasn’t really stopped yet.
lines.zh: : {i}和{/i}我发生那件事的女孩，从此理所当然地恨了我一辈子……永远。她到现在还没真的停下来。

lines.en: : Does this mean you are you going to despise me?! For the accident?!
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着你会恨我？！因为这场事故？！

lines.en: : An accident is just that. I won’t hold it against you.
lines.zh: : 事故就是事故。我不会怪你。

lines.en: : But you might want to back off for now since your {i}daughter{/i} is watching us.
lines.zh: : 不过你现在可能该退开一点了，因为你{i}女儿{/i}正看着我们呢。

lines.en: : A baby was already formed?! Maybe I do not understand mating rituals at all!
lines.zh: : 已经造出小宝宝了吗？！也许我根本不懂交配仪式！
: 我说的是 Nao……

lines.en: : Ahh! Nao-chan! Shield your vision balls! You are not yet prepared to see the scary things large humans do!
lines.zh: : 啊！Nao-chan！遮住你的视觉球！你还没准备好看到大型人类做的那些可怕的事！

lines.en: Kaori sends Nao back inside and...I suppose we’ve reached the part of the night where she apologizes for what happened and then heads back in herself.
lines.zh: Kaori 把 Nao 送回屋里，然后……我想，这一晚已经到了她为刚才发生的事道歉、然后自己也回屋去的段落。

lines.en: The thing is, she doesn’t {i}need{/i} to apologize.
lines.zh: 问题是，她根本不{i}需要{/i}道歉。

lines.en: If anything, I should be {i}thanking{/i} her as that spontaneous make out session was somehow able to set me back on the right course.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我反倒该{i}谢谢{/i}她，因为那场突如其来的热吻，不知怎么地让我重新回到了正轨上。

lines.en: When I told you things have been looking up, I was lying.
lines.zh: 我跟你说的「一切都在好转」，是谎话。

lines.en: I’m sure that’s obvious in hindsight, but you need to see this from my perspective to truly understand.
lines.zh: 我相信事后看来这很明显，不过你得站在我的角度，才能真正明白。
对我来说，这一点都{i}不{/i}明显。
{i}现在{/i}也不明显。

lines.en: Because while the residual effects of a novocaine tongue still linger in my mouth, I know better than anyone that numbness is only temporary.
lines.zh: 因为尽管奴佛卡因般的舌头带来的余韵还留在我的嘴里，我却比任何人都清楚，麻木只是暂时的。

lines.en: And as soon as I walk away from this apartment, even that will start to fade.
lines.zh: 而等我走出这间公寓，就连那一点也会开始消退。
确实有什么东西跟着我到了这儿。
你看不见它。
但我能。

lines.en: : The cotton candy girl will not be happy with the kiss that I have done.
lines.zh: : 棉花糖女孩不会对我做的这个亲吻高兴的。

lines.en: : She is the one you should be doing this kissing with.
lines.zh: : 你该和她做这种亲吻才对。
: 你……经常和她说话吗？

lines.en: : Only when she has a wiener in her mouth.
lines.zh: : 只有在她嘴里叼着香肠的时候。

lines.en: : She says many words about you. And you would form an attractive human together if you mated.
lines.zh: : 她说了你很多事。而且如果你俩交配，会造出一个很好看的人类。

lines.en: : Are we still allowed to be friends?
lines.zh: : 我们还可以继续做朋友吗？
: 为什么不可以？

lines.en: : Because there is an invisible line humans always talk about and I can not see it because it is invisible but, if I could, I think I would have stepped over it when I did the kiss.
lines.zh: : 因为人类总在说有一条看不见的线，而我看不见它，因为它是看不见的，可如果我能看见，我想我做那个亲吻的时候，就已经跨过去了。

lines.en: : It was an accident. I don’t even remember the line. The world just changed all of a sudden and when my sight-spheres became normal sight-spheres again, you were right in front of me.
lines.zh: : 那是个意外。我连那条线都不记得。世界突然就变了，等我的视觉球重新变回正常的视觉球，你就已经在我面前了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. It won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 对不起。不会再发生了。

lines.en: : It...can if you want it to.
lines.zh: : 如果……你想的话，也可以再发生。

lines.en: : Why would I want it to? I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我为什么会想？我不明白。

lines.en: : You are Friend, not Special Friend. Repeating the kiss with you will give you a new name and you do not like the new names you receive.
lines.zh: : 你是朋友，不是特殊的朋友。和你重复那个亲吻，会给你一个新名字，而你不喜欢你得到的那些新名字。

lines.en: : True. But I liked kissing you. Even if it...wasn’t really my decision.
lines.zh: : 没错。可我喜欢亲你。哪怕那……并不真的是我自己的决定。

lines.en: : What about it did you like?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢它哪一点？

lines.en: : I mean...that’s not really a question that’s easy to answer. I just did.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这问题真不好回答。我就是喜欢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for asking a difficult question. I just do not possess any memories of it and wanted to see if I could have your memories move into my brain and build a thought-house there.
lines.zh: : 抱歉问了个难答的问题。我只是没有那段记忆，想看看能不能让你的记忆搬进我的大脑，在那里盖一座思想的房子。

lines.en: : On second thought, yeah. Maybe it’s better if we don’t do that again.
lines.zh: : 再想想，是啊。也许我们还是别再那样了比较好。

lines.en: : Yes. Now we are reading the same page.
lines.zh: : 是的。现在我们读到同一页了。

lines.en: : Can your legs take you to the place you need to go next? Or will one of them run away?
lines.zh: : 你的腿能带你去下一个该去的地方吗？还是说其中一条会跑掉？

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ll get home fine. Apologies in advance for all of the questions Nao will have for you, though.
lines.zh: : 我肯定能好好到家。不过先替 Nao 待会儿要问你的所有问题向你道歉。

lines.en: : Nao-chan does not ask questions. She has not learned that yet. But I will add mating and courting rituals to the list of things she needs to make brain-room for.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 不问问题。她还没学会。不过我会把交配仪式和求偶仪式，加进她需要腾出脑内空间来装的清单里。

lines.en: : Yeah, maybe wait a few years before you give her all of the details. But I’ll get out of your hair now. I’ve fucked up your night more than enough already.
lines.zh: : 是啊，细节什么的也许等几年再说。不过我现在就不打扰你了。我已经把你这一晚搅得够乱了。

lines.en: : All you did was make my heart go babababa and that is not a bad thing. But it is a thing. And now I have to wait for the babababa to stop.
lines.zh: : 你不过就是让我的心 babababa 地跳，这不算坏事。可它毕竟是件事。现在我得等着这个 babababa 停下来。

lines.en: : I will be in my housebox if you need me.
lines.zh: : 你需要我的话，我会在我的房子盒子里。

lines.en: : And if you ever think something is behind you, remember to make yourself look big.
lines.zh: : 还有，要是你觉得身后有什么东西，记得把自己弄得很高大。

lines.en: : The world is scary when you are small.
lines.zh: : 当你很渺小的时候，世界是很可怕的。

lines.en: : That is why the fieldmice hide.
lines.zh: : 那就是田鼠要躲起来的原因。
